svg.title: A-201 Exterior Elevations — Detailed Four Views
svg.text: A-201 — Detailed Exterior Elevations — Four Views
1/8″ = 1′-0″ · Estimating / Field Verification · REV E · REPRESENTATIVE / FIELD VERIFY
1. 1. Verify roof framing, pitch, overhangs, ventilation, flashing, gutters, and all penetrations.
2. 2. Rear deck/porch, patio door, ledger, guards, stairs, and grade require final coordinated design.
3. 3. Verify electrical, gas, HVAC, water, sewer, camera, and communication service locations.
4. 4. Window/door units, trim, siding, foundation exposure, and finish grades require field verification and approved schedules.
